recommendation: Continue the exact v51 SOL Range Onset route unchanged. Current prospective readiness-only context evidence does not support activating the dual-MTF challenger or loosening the hourly-cross requirement.
why_now: The immutable current-run prefix expands the prospective sample from an initial 89 readiness rows to 647 scorecard evaluations and contains independent clear and opposed context onsets. It still contains no eligible hourly crossover, so it can test context behavior before entry but cannot estimate route expectancy.
observed_problem_or_opportunity: The route remains selective because no completed hourly SMA10/30 crossover occurred. The dual-MTF challenger was measured on every scored observation, but clear context did not consistently outperform opposed context and neither independent onset cohort cleared the 13-bps estimated round-trip hurdle at 5, 15, 30, or 60 minutes.
applicable_market_regime: Prospective SOL short-structure readiness observations under measured completed 5-minute and 15-minute context before a fresh hourly crossover.
alternatives_considered: Activate the dual-MTF context gate now, rejected because there are zero eligible route lifecycles and no stable clear-versus-opposed separation.
Remove the hourly-cross requirement to increase frequency, rejected because independent readiness-only paths remain negative after modeled friction and largest-observation removal.
Reactivate the previously rejected aligned-range relaxation, rejected because no new qualifying evidence satisfies its reopen condition.
Continue the exact route and collect eligible long and short lifecycles, selected.
expected_upside: Preserves a historically selective mechanism while preventing autocorrelated readiness rows from being mistaken for independent profitable trades. The next eligible lifecycle will supply direct execution, exit, and context evidence without contaminating the control.
main_risks_and_failure_modes: Zero eligible lifecycles means the current window cannot estimate live route expectancy.
All scored readiness rows have short structural direction, so long-side context coverage is absent.
Context-onset returns are completed-candle counterfactuals rather than orders or fills.
The 13-bps friction hurdle is modeled and does not include every future funding, latency, or market-impact realization.
Historical SOL profitability is concentrated in rare large winners, so a filter may remove the events that carry the edge.
Clear/opposed onset cells are small and chronological dependence can make apparent differences unstable.
validation_completed: The immutable prefix is bound to the exact v51 run, profile, and fingerprint.
Technical coverage is complete with zero runtime faults, zero metric-value gaps, and no missing market-data observations.
The route emitted 647 scorecard evaluations, zero eligible signals, and zero resolved eligible horizons.
The readiness aggregate recorded 648 observations: 297 blocked only by the hourly cross and 351 blocked by both the hourly cross and 5-minute admission.
The context metric covered all 647 scored observations: 562 clear and 85 opposed.
Independent context-onset outcomes were separated from repeated one-minute rows at every measured horizon.
Broader non-overlapping readiness paths were negative after modeled friction and remained negative after removing the largest close observation at every horizon.
validation_still_required: At least one attributable eligible and fully resolved SOL lifecycle in every observed side and context cohort.
Exact entry and exit fills, fees, funding, slippage, latency, stop behavior, and maximum-hold attribution.
Chronological stability and largest-winner sensitivity for eligible lifecycles rather than readiness-only paths.
An unchanged-route comparison that quantifies opportunity cost before any context filter is proposed.
success_metrics: Eligible clear-context lifecycles outperform opposed lifecycles after exact costs without relying on the largest winner.
A challenger improves unchanged-route net result and drawdown across independent chronological episodes.
Both long and short retain positive after-cost evidence under the proposed policy.
Research and live completed-bar context labels reconcile row-for-row.
failure_or_rollback_triggers: Opposed eligible entries equal or outperform clear eligible entries after exact costs.
The challenger removes a disproportionate share of profitable canonical events.
Any research/live context-label mismatch or unexplained routing suppression appears.
Results become non-positive after largest-winner removal or realistic friction stress.
A material route, profile, sizing, stop, or exit identity change invalidates this prospective window.

independent_context_onset_sensitivity.interpretation: Completed-candle directional paths from independent context onsets. After-friction values subtract the frozen 13-bps hurdle and are not fills or PnL.

broader_readiness_path_sensitivity.interpretation: All independent readiness annotations, regardless of context state. These are not hypothetical fills or permission to remove blockers.

minimum_additional_evidence.to_update_diagnosis: At least one fully resolved prospective canonical SOL lifecycle in every observed context and side cohort; absence of a cohort remains an explicit coverage result.
minimum_additional_evidence.for_change_recommendation: A predeclared compatible window with independent eligible episodes, exact execution costs, side-specific results, chronological stability, unchanged-route comparison, and largest-winner sensitivity.

decision: Keep the context challenger report-only and preserve the current SOL strategy, sizing, leverage, stop, hold, and execution behavior.
single_highest_value_next_investigation: Resolve the first exact source-native SP500 lifecycle already open in v51; for SOL specifically, capture the first canonical eligible lifecycle and preserve its decision-time clear/opposed context.
limitations: No eligible SOL signal or closed SOL lifecycle exists in the evaluated prefix.
Context-onset paths are readiness diagnostics rather than executed trades.
All scored rows carry short structural direction; long-side behavior remains unobserved.
Context-specific largest-winner sensitivity is unavailable in the current metric diagnostic.
No live strategy, route, parameter, leverage, sizing, exit, or authority changed from this review.
